params.name: key
params.description: the key of the set, must not be null.

params.name: members
params.description: the members to get the time to live for, must not be null or empty.

returns.description: a list with one Long per member, in the order of members: the remaining time to live in milliseconds, 0 if the member is expiring now; -1 if the member exists but has no expiration; -2 if the member does not exist (a logically expired member does not exist) or key does not exist.
